name: TX-29
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Sylvia Garcia running with large fundraising edge
Republican challenger has raised no money
No polling or expert ratings available
model.rationale: The baseline of D+23.8 rests on a heavily Democratic Houston-area district, an entrenched incumbent, and a Republican opponent with zero reported fundraising. Prediction markets price Garcia near 94%, consistent with a Safe D rating; I keep the baseline margin and widen uncertainty slightly given the absence of polls.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing the challenger competitive, or major outside spending against Garcia, would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Sylvia Garcia, the Democratic incumbent, is seeking another term in a Houston-area district that leans Democratic by about 17 points. She has raised nearly a million dollars and enjoys outside support, while her Republican challenger, Martha Fierro, reports no fundraising or outside backing. No general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race.

The quantitative baseline points to a Democratic margin of roughly 24 points, and prediction markets put Garcia's chances around 94 percent. With no evidence of a competitive race, this remains Safe Democratic, though the lack of polling means uncertainty is somewhat elevated.
